name: Love MorteM ReborN
source: In Love MorteM ReborN, you take the role of a man who works for a nightclub called Awakening. - Immerse yourself in a world of Dark Fantasy, with touches of cyberpunk and horror. - Learn and unravel all the mysteries of the island, while meeting different people on your way. - The world and the characters will react to your actions... Although you will surely react to them as well.​
translation: 在《Love MorteM ReborN》中，你扮演一个在名为Awakening的夜总会工作的男人。- 让自己沉浸在充满赛博朋克和恐怖气息的黑暗幻想世界中。- 了解并解开岛上的所有秘密，同时在路上遇到不同的人。- 世界和角色会对你的行为做出反应…尽管你肯定也会对他们做出反应。
